name: Hartalega Holdings Berhad
overview: 2026年公司未公布新的产能扩张、新业务或出售计划，公告主要为季度业绩、股东大会及股息相关事项。最新一季（2026-09-30）营收同比增长19.5%，净利润同比增长79.3%。
overview_en: In 2026, the company did not announce new capacity expansion, new business, or divestment plans; announcements were mainly quarterly results, general meetings, and dividend-related matters. In the latest quarter (2026-09-30), revenue increased 19.5% year-on-year and net profit increased 79.3% year-on-year.
